linked: Linked to Leafdesk as {name}. Ask me anything about {workspace}: I answer from the pages you can open there. /help lists what else I can do.
linkedNoWorkspace: Linked to Leafdesk as {name}. You aren't in a workspace I can answer from yet: join one, then pick it with /workspace.
notLinked: This chat isn't linked to a Leafdesk account. In Leafdesk, open Settings → Connected apps → Telegram and choose Link Telegram.
badCode: That link has run out or was used already. Make a new one in Leafdesk: Settings → Connected apps → Telegram.
help:
Ask a question, or send a voice message, and I answer from your Leafdesk pages, citing them.

/new: start a new conversation
/workspace: choose the workspace I answer from
/mode: choose what I may change
/stop: stop the answer being written
/notifications: turn your notifications in this chat on or off
/unlink: unlink this Telegram account

commands.workspace: Choose the workspace I answer from
commands.notifications: Turn notifications here on or off

pickWorkspace: Which workspace should I answer from? Now: {workspace}.
pickWorkspaceNone: Which workspace should I answer from?
workspaceSet: Questions now go to {workspace}, in a new conversation.
noWorkspace: You aren't in a workspace I can answer from. Its owners may have turned connected apps off; pick another with /workspace.
pickMode: What may I change in your workspace? Now: {mode}.
readOnlyWorkspace: Apps may only read in {workspace}, so I answer without changing anything there.
busy: I'm still answering your last question. Send /stop to stop it.
nothingToStop: I'm not answering anything right now.
unlinked: This Telegram account is no longer linked to Leafdesk.
unlinkedInSettings: Your Leafdesk account was unlinked from this chat in Leafdesk's settings.
onlyPrivate: I only answer in a private chat.
onlyText: Send me a question as text or as a voice message.
voiceOff: This server can't write down voice messages. Send your question as text.
voiceFailed: I couldn't write down that voice message. Try again, or type the question.
voiceTooLong: That voice message is too long. Keep it under {minutes} min.
sourceGone: A page you can no longer open
cutOff: The answer reached the length limit and may be cut off.

notifications.on: Your Leafdesk notifications come to this chat. Settings → Preferences chooses which kinds.
notifications.off: Your Leafdesk notifications don't come to this chat.

notify.gone: This notification isn't in your inbox anymore.
notify.notWhole: Not all of this call shows here: approve it from its run in Leafdesk.
notify.notePrompt: What should the agent change? Answer this message with a note.

call.sentBack: Sent back with your note: the agent tries again.
call.changed: The agent asked again since: answer its new call.
call.forbidden: Only the owners this run is for answer its calls.
call.readOnly: Apps may only read in this workspace: answer the call in Leafdesk.
call.notWhole: Not all of this call shows here: approve it from its run in Leafdesk.
call.emptyNote: Write what the agent should change, in answer to the question.

approval.createPageTop: Add the page {title} at the top of the workspace, private to you?
approval.createPdf: Make the PDF {title} of {target} and attach it there?
approval.createDatabaseTop: Add the database {title} at the top of the workspace, private to you?

publicForm.signedIn: It gets a public link: anyone with it can answer after signing in.
publicForm.anonymous: It gets a public link: anyone with it can answer, without signing in.

errors.disabled: AI is turned off in this workspace.
errors.noAccess: That workspace or conversation isn't available anymore. Start over with /new.
errors.tooLarge: That question is too long, or this conversation is full. Shorten it or start over with /new.
errors.rateLimited: Too many questions at once. Try again in a moment.
errors.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.provider: The AI provider couldn't answer. Try again later.
errors.empty: The AI gave no answer. Try asking another way.
errors.interrupted: The server restarted while answering. Ask again.
errors.limitReached: This workspace reached its monthly AI cost limit, so questions are refused until next month.
